ops.title: T fixtures DSL + testing overhaul shipped (bd744bdc + 47da9fb8): namespaced T builders public, inline corpus migrated, pytest consolidated; gotchas that bit during the wave
ops.body:
Testing-overhaul wave shipped 2026-07-21 on main: `bd744bdc` (feat: namespaced `T` fixture DSL — `T.user/assistant/tool/result/thinking/tool_turn` in `captain_hook/testing/fixtures.py`, exported top-level + `captain_hook.testing` lazy `__getattr__`/`__dir__`; whole builtin-pack + docs/examples inline-test corpus migrated off raw transcript dicts; docs/skills teach T) and `47da9fb8` (refactor(tests): suite consolidated — `tool_payload`/`write_hook`/`make_project`/`assert_inline_tests(label)` in tests/helpers.py, per-file bridge `tests/test_builtin_inline.py`, review_helpers wraps `cc_transcript.synthetic`, daemon helpers deduped). Full plan: acct plans/our-inline-tests-need-velvety-valley.md.

**Why:** hook authors hand-rolled `{"type": "assistant", "message": {...}}` dicts and parked test-only constants at module level; three parallel raw-builder families had grown in tests/.

**How to apply:**
- Transcript fixtures in `tests={...}` are `T.*` inline — never named module constants ([[constants-inline-by-default]]). Raw dicts still accepted and mix freely; envelope synthesis stays in `fixture_line`.
- The legacy `raw_msg`/`raw_text`/`raw_tool_msg`/`raw_tool_result`/`raw_text_block` core in tests/helpers.py is KEPT deliberately: `parse_event`/disk-JSONL tests need full envelopes bare `T` lines lack (`parse_event` raises `KeyError: 'uuid'`) — don't "finish" deleting it.
- `T.tool` auto-mints `tu-<n>` ids from a module `count()`; explicit ids must stay outside that namespace or the parser mis-pairs results.
- Gotchas that bit: `codex:codex-wrapper` agentType absent in workflow context (codex down → all sol lanes fell back to opus); a workflow agent ending its turn on a background Bash never wakes (cleanup lane died mid-gate — foreground only); StructuredOutput retry-cap can kill a lane AFTER its work landed (reconcile from disk); a concurrent session's kitchen-sink commit (fb6072ac) swept our uncommitted P0 hunks; whole-suite single-process pytest hits a pre-existing spaCy/pydantic sys.modules flake (papercut 119a273, inoculate by pre-importing spacy).
- PR #12 cleanup: spec-lane artifact validated then applied post-ship; upstream c12a30e3 hoisted `RewritingExistingPlan` into the package mid-wave — plans.py imports it now.
